settings: intro-times-lookup ; analyzer-error-wait ; step-heartbeat ; intro-search-window ; credits-search-window ; intro-sibling-agreement ; segment-max-share ; worker-poll-interval
note: An outside database of intro times first, then black frames, silence, subtitle gaps, chapter names, and an episode's siblings

capability: Read a title's chapters from its original, and of titles that miss them at a set pace
served_by: route:katalog-manager:PUT /api/chapters/items/{itemId} ; route:katalog-manager:GET /api/chapters/items/{itemId} ; route:katalog-manager:DELETE /api/chapters/items/{itemId} ; route:katalog-manager:POST /api/chapters/claim ; graphql:katalog-manager:query chapterReads
settings: chapters-backfill ; chapters-backfill-window ; chapters-backfill-inflight ; chapters-backfill-rate ; chapters-backfill-records ; chapters-backfill-lease ; chapter-backfill-claims ; chapter-read-timeout ; chapter-read-failures
note: Kept in the catalog, not the package; an original stays until they are read. The chapters tab lists them; progress API only

capability: Settle titles whose chapters can't be read, or put back chapters a read replaced
note: API only. Accepting an unreadable title lets its original go without its chapters

capability: Measure the picture inside a title's frame, and of titles that lack it at a set pace
served_by: route:katalog-manager:GET /api/picture/items/{id} ; route:katalog-manager:PUT /api/picture/items/{id} ; route:katalog-manager:GET /api/picture/extras/{id} ; route:katalog-manager:PUT /api/picture/extras/{id} ; route:katalog-manager:POST /api/picture/claim ; graphql:katalog-manager:query pictureAreas
settings: picture-backfill ; picture-backfill-window ; picture-backfill-inflight ; picture-backfill-rate ; picture-backfill-lease ; picture-on-arrival ; picture-backfill-claims ; picture-nice ; picture-threads ; picture-pass-deadline ; picture-measure-again
note: From the original: the bars baked into the frame, for the players to fit. Not shown in the console

capability: Encode a title's video to the master spec, copying a source that already meets it
settings: video-caps ; decoder ; x264-preset ; x264-crf ; x265-preset ; x265-crf ; encode-stall-timeout ; worker-poll-interval ; rules-report-interval
note: HEVC within the caps. The resource sets the encoder, the ladder and the segment length (spec.pipeline, features.gpu)

capability: Package a title to play: segments, audio, subtitles, scrub thumbnails and checksums
settings: shown-languages ; keep-single-language ; surround-bitrate ; old-package-grace ; packager-error-wait ; stereo-loudness ; trickplay-interval ; trickplay-size ; superseded-grace ; worker-poll-interval ; rules-report-interval ; audio-language-rules
note: Every track as stereo AAC, quiet mixes lifted. 5.1, segment length, default language, HLS subtitles: spec.pipeline

capability: Encode and package a title's extras on a chain of their own
note: Transcode, then package: no intro or credits pass, no scrub thumbnails. Their ladder: spec.pipeline.extraLadder. Not in the console

capability: Package a title now, or encode it again under the pipeline's current settings
served_by: graphql:katalog-manager:mutation packageItem ; graphql:katalog-manager:mutation reencodeItem ; route:katalog-manager:POST /api/items/{id}/package ; route:chino-api:POST /api/v1/admin/items/{id}/package ; route:chino-api:GET /api/v1/admin/items/{id}/package
note: The current package plays until the new one is in place. Refused once the original is retired. No app calls chino-api's route

capability: Make subtitles in the instance's languages where a title has none
note: The subtitler, run by hand as a Job over a list of titles; no pipeline step. It also makes OCR copies, which ADR-0015 rules out

capability: Attach a subtitle file to a title, and remove one it attached
note: Kept as WebVTT beside the title's version, labelled by how it was made (AI, OCR); nothing is packaged again

capability: Convert a title as it plays where its package doesn't fit the device or the connection
served_by: route:live-worker:POST /v1/segment ; route:live-worker:POST /v1/init ; route:live-worker:POST /v1/subtitle ; route:live-worker:GET /v1/status ; route:live-worker:GET /v1/jobs ; route:live-worker:GET /v1/stats
settings: live-queue ; live-deadlines ; live-attempts ; live-watchdog ; live-circuit-breaker ; live-threads ; live-tonemap ; live-hw-frames ; live-process-timeouts ; live-audio-bitrate ; live-diagnostics
note: By default chino-stream's own encoder; spec.liveWorker, mode on, sends it to the live worker. Rungs beside the package not built

capability: Retry failed steps by themselves after a backoff, and take silent ones for failed
settings: retry-attempts ; retry-backoff ; retry-backoff-max ; retry-interval ; step-timeouts ; step-heartbeat
note: Three runs in a row, waits of 1 min doubling to 1 h, then failed for an admin. The processing view shows the policy

capability: See which steps failed and why, and retry one or every one
served_by: graphql:katalog-manager:query processingOverview ; graphql:katalog-manager:mutation retryStep ; graphql:katalog-manager:mutation retryFailed ; graphql:katalog-manager:query retryPolicy
note: Each step's titles by state; the failed ones with their last error, the latest first, 100 at most in the console

capability: Follow what the pipeline does to each title, as it happens
screens: screen:katalog-manager-ui:ActivityView ; tab:katalog-manager-ui:ActivityView friendly ; tab:katalog-manager-ui:ActivityView technical ; tab:katalog-manager-ui:KatalogLayout activity
note: A feed of step changes, in plain words or technical, pushed live by the catalog's stream

capability: Install the whole platform from one resource in a namespace
settings: part-of-label ; image-pull-secrets ; replica-counts ; service-addresses ; listen-ports ; web-app-paths ; kubernetes-api ; portal-cluster-scope ; operator-api-names ; outside-service-keys ; bug-report-target ; tool-paths ; image-version-stamp
note: The operator renders its embedded chart, about 16 services, with server-side apply and reverts edits to what it manages

capability: Sign people in through the bundled identity provider or an external one
settings: identity-mode ; oidc-issuer ; issuer-scheme ; token-audience ; sign-in-clients ; service-clients ; people-admin-client ; role-names ; token-checks ; login-theme ; keycloak-image ; issuer-host-alias ; password-policy-hint ; public-host
note: Portal: the setup checklist shows the mode and the issuer, changes neither. identity.loginTheme is read by no template

capability: Publish the bundled identity provider's admin console on the public host
note: Off: only /auth/realms and /auth/resources are public; the console answers through a port-forward

capability: Serve the platform at its public host, through an Ingress or Routes
note: Path-routed on one host; subdomains adds chino's own. Portal: the setup checklist shows the origin, changes nothing

capability: Serve the platform over https with a certificate of its own
note: A Secret or a cert-manager issuer; Routes carry it inline. Portal shows only whether it is https. No docs page names spec.tls

capability: Give the library, the database and the event broker their volumes
settings: media-size ; media-access-mode ; media-claim-provision ; storage-class ; database-volume-size ; database-volume-class ; database-claim ; database-migrate ; broker-claim ; broker-node ; media-paths
note: Postgres leaves an emptyDir only with storage.postgres.migrate. Portal: the setup checklist shows the library's claim only

capability: Keep the databases on the bundled Postgres or on an external one
note: single renders exactly as perApp: no template reads it. external: the databases are made beforehand

capability: Use the bundled event broker or an external one shared with others
settings: broker-claim ; broker-node ; event-broker-mode ; bundled-broker ; kafka-brokers ; kafka-tls ; event-topics ; consumer-groups
note: External: a bootstrap list, an mTLS Secret, a topic prefix and a consumer-group prefix per instance

capability: Encode titles on an NVIDIA GPU or on the CPU
note: gpu: NVENC on a node offering nvidia.com/gpu; cpu: x264/x265 anywhere. The setup checklist reads features.gpu instead

capability: Choose the renditions, segments, audio and subtitles the packages get
settings: rendition-ladder ; extras-ladder ; segment-length ; surround-audio ; playlist-subtitles ; default-audio-language ; speech-recognition ; chapters-lookup
note: Empty fields keep each worker's own default; a change reaches new packages only. Of these fields the docs name only surroundAudio

capability: Run the live worker for the encodes made while a title plays
settings: nvenc-quality ; live-worker-switch ; live-worker-mode ; live-worker-slots ; live-worker-gpu ; live-worker-placement ; live-worker-resources ; stream-encoder ; stream-gpu ; service-tokens ; live-worker-wiring
note: Mode off, shadow or on; GPU or CPU slots. Without it chino-stream encodes itself, on the CPU; features.gpu changes nothing

capability: Back up the bundled databases on a schedule, keeping the newest dumps
settings: backup-switch ; backup-schedule ; backup-retention ; backup-volume-size ; backup-volume-class ; backup-claim
note: Bundled Postgres only; on by default where it is on a claim. Each dump carries its checksums; status.backup lists them

capability: Restore the bundled databases from one of their dumps
note: Asked with the annotation zaentrum.io/restore-request naming a dump: clients stop, it is checked, restored, restarted

capability: Choose the release channel, and whether its updates apply themselves
note: stable: the newest release; edge: latest. manual reports status.availableUpdate; auto rolls to it

capability: Give addons a VPN their pods reach the internet through
note: Pods labelled zaentrum.io/vpn reach only the cluster networks directly; addons get the proxy in their values. No platform pod uses it

capability: Provide the platform's secrets yourself instead of generated ones
note: Off: the operator generates each Secret once and never rotates it; on: it makes, reads and reports none

capability: Install the whole platform on one machine as a single container
note: a cluster of its own in one privileged container; amd64; answers on the machine it runs on alone

capability: Reach it from the home's phones and TVs with no name or certificate of one's own
note: sign-in needs https on every name but localhost, and the Android apps refuse plain http

capability: Reach it from outside the home with no router or DNS setup
Run the platform on an ARM machine
note: every image is built for amd64 alone

capability: Encode on an Intel or AMD graphics chip, or a Mac's
note: the encoders are NVIDIA's and the CPU's

capability: Move the platform to another machine with its people, settings, history and library
note: a dump restores into the install that made it; nothing carries an install over

capability: Watch live channels
note: registered only: a seeded app and tile, switched off, badged soon; nothing behind them

capability: Listen to music
note: registered only: a seeded app and tile, switched off, badged soon; nothing behind them

capability: Listen to audiobooks and podcasts
note: in the same app as music; nothing is registered or built for it
